message.content: {"hts_code": "8528.71.8000", "reason": "The Android-based touchscreen flat-panel smart video display with integrated CPU, memory, and wireless connectivity is classified under heading 8528 as reception apparatus for television, and because it is not a television receiver but a display unit capable of receiving signals, it falls under subheading 8528.71 (other reception apparatus not designed to incorporate a video display, or with video display other than cathode-ray tube), with the residual statistical suffix 8000."}

predicted_reason: The Android-based touchscreen flat-panel smart video display with integrated CPU, memory, and wireless connectivity is classified under heading 8528 as reception apparatus for television, and because it is not a television receiver but a display unit capable of receiving signals, it falls under subheading 8528.71 (other reception apparatus not designed to incorporate a video display, or with video display other than cathode-ray tube), with the residual statistical suffix 8000.
